description: Mekong Regional Hydropower Dams 2020 is a dataset from Open Development Mekong listing known operational, planned, postponed, potential and under-construction hydropower dams in the Mekong region. It was compiled from the Greater Mekong Dams Observatory, the CGIAR Challenge Program on Water and Food Mekong for basin dams, the Mekong Infrastructure Tracker, the USAID Mekong Safeguards Project and other public sources including news and government websites, then cleaned by the ODM team. The table has 551 rows with status, capacity, year of completion, sponsors, lenders and construction companies with their countries, administrative location, tributary, coordinates and average annual output. Coverage is Cambodia, Laos, Myanmar, Thailand and Viet Nam from 1954 to 2020. Access is free under CC BY-SA as GeoJSON, a table dump, WMS and the CKAN datastore API. Caveats: the data come from secondary sources, the metadata were last revised in February 2022, and the DataHub holds older and national dam layers that overlap this one. Simulation uses: hydropower and reservoir network models, dam break and flood exposure, and planning scenarios with the dam pipeline. Related records: the NTU Mekong dams database (data-mekong-dams-database-ntu) and the MRC Data Portal (data-mrc-mekong-river-commission-data-portal).
